title: Retry policy retries fatal errors
statement: `retry.py` wraps a callable with retries, but it retries every exception, including fatal ones. Repair it using the exception types in `errors.py` so the tests under `tests/` pass: only `TransientError` is retried; `FatalError` and unexpected exceptions propagate on the first call; when retries are exhausted the last `TransientError` is re-raised.
